"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will make it easier for workers, public and private, to exercise their right to organize and join unions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to pass laws that direct the National Labor Relations Board to certify a union if a simple majority of eligible workers sign valid authorization cards.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to pass laws that bring companies to the negotiating table.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support binding arbitration to help workers who have voted to join a union reach a first contract.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A major factor in the 40-year decline in the middle class is that the rights of workers to bargain collectively for better wages and benefits have been under attack at all levels.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump would make matters worse by creating a race to the bottom where the middle class is fighting over fewer and fewer good-paying jobs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump rejected some attempts by his own employees to unionize.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump has personally hired union-busting firms to undermine workers' rights.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
